entities.summary: Miyake clan  were a samurai kin group which rose to prominence in the Sengoku period and the Edo period. Under the Tokugawa shogunate, the Miyake were hereditary vassals of the Tokugawa clan. The Miyake were classified as one of the fudai daimyō clans.
